messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] region=us-east primary-gpu-pool=primary-v3 queue_depth=3200 queue_growth=+800/5m autoscaler_status=FAILED reason=scale_limit_reached :rotating_light:
Jamie: ack. I'm on it. tagging @Dan (oncall) and @Miguel.@Miguel can you look at runtime KV/cache saturation?
Dan: paging in progress. I'm spinning up console and checking autoscaler logs. first glance: autoscaler returned 403 from cloud quota API at 09:14 UTC.
Miguel: looking. runtime heap and KV cache look fine but queue sits at 3k, per-token latency SLOs tripping. evictions high around 09:11. suspect we hit our soft GPU limit for the account in us-east.
Priya: if quota is the culprit we should steer new requests to region-us-west-2 and eu-west-1. we have steer policies but need to avoid jamming eu. propose temporary routing weight change: set us-east weight=0.6, us-west=0.25, eu-west=0.15.
Dan: agree. preparing to apply routing delta via redwoodctl. will push canary then promote.
Dan: executing:
```
# temporarily reduce us-east traffic
redwoodctl routing update --policy cross-region-fallback --set-weight us-east=0.6,us-west=0.25,eu-west=0.15 --dry-run=false
```
Dan: applied at 09:23 UTC. observing tail. adding 60s monitor.
Miguel: also enabling model-variant fallback for long requests: map requests > 1024 tokens -> quantized-small variant to reduce per-request GPU usage. snippet:
```
"routing": {"conditions": [{"expr": "request.tokens > 1024", "target":"gptx-quant-small"}]}
```
Priya: I'm also flipping the "burst-capacity" toggle on dedicated pool -> allow 12 extra GPUs for 10m bursts. note: cloud quota error might still block if account quota exhausted. @Kim can you confirm quota status?
Kim: confirmed: us-east GPU quota at account level shows limit 48 and all allocated. I've requested a temporary quota bump with cloud provider, but approval ETA ~30-45m. Meanwhile I can provision cross-account pool in us-west with 16GPUs.
Ana: support update draft: "We are seeing higher latencies and some 5xx for requests routed to us-east. We have begun traffic steering to alternate regions and expect improvement within 5-15 minutes. Impact: ~12 customers experienced degraded responses between 09:10-09:25 UTC. Working on mitigation and will post updates." Anyone want to add specifics on impacted product surfaces?
Miguel: add that long-context batch jobs are most affected; small chat endpoints recovered faster post-routing changes.
Jamie: observed drop in queue from 3200 -> 950 over 6 minutes after routing change and model-variant fallback. token-p95 latency down from 1.8s -> 0.9s for routed requests. some in-flight jobs still failing due to OOM in older variant though.
Dan: I requeued failing jobs to secondary region via internal replayer. command: `replayer replay --from-pool primary-v3 --to-pool us-west-dedicated-1 --filter status=queued` -> started at 09:31 UTC.
Kim: provisioned cross-account us-west pool is healthy (16 GPUs) and integrated into routing at 09:35 UTC, spike absorbed. cloud quota still pending but routing change is sustainable for now.
Ana: posting a short customer update to status page now.
Jamie: for post-incident: we need action items: 1) autoscaler should fail open to spill to secondary if quota API returns 403, 2) add a circuit-breaker to throttle very long token requests, 3) run quota drain tests in canary, 4) improve observability around per-account GPU usage.
Priya: I'll own autoscaler fallback ticket. Miguel will own model-variant mapping and circuit-breaker. Kim will follow up on quota approvals and cross-account provisioning runbook. Ana will draft post-mortem blurb for customers.
Miguel: quick note — we should also add an automated playbook step: if queue_growth > 500/5m AND autoscaler_status=FAILED -> auto-deploy routing change to reduce weight of primary region by 30%.
Jamie: good. Closing incident channel for active mitigation; keep thread open for postmortem notes. thanks all :thumbsup:
